what: The GPU code of study 5's extension 2 after its fourth and fifth amendments (the exact Hessian–vector product of δ_lin, its derivative probe, the attention kernel's diagnostic and the math-kernel gradient): the identity of its GPU paths at the commit named.
engineering_check: docs/study5-preregistration.md, extension 2's amendments 4 and 5. The one GPU path changed since pod 4's record is the linearized replay; its default path (the production gradient pass) was checked on the derivative probe's Pod at d303b12d96e05985c199d63463bd50f721655674: the frozen-gradient displacement δ̂ of the probe's exact recursions (archive dlin-probe-20261115: exact-s50000-a, exact-s50000-b, exact-s50025-a) is byte-identical to pod 4's replays of the same seeds at 490eada (archive pod4-20261111, linear/s50000 and linear/s50025): δ̂'s file sha256 a4177d35efef28c684f4da486da8a77d042d0146b551089da07a2b982e9f0367 (seed 50000, both runs) and 5dbc958ed27a6150e265feb82f87d7f2b0ac338b939c25918007c13edfabae50 (seed 50025). The file holds the named tensors only (vectors.save_vector; its provenance is a separate record), so equal files are equal tensors. The check is reused for this commit: from d303b12 to 1c92c7d the replay gained the math-kernel gradient (--gradient-backend math) and the kernel diagnostic, and the default backend's pass is the same call of train.accumulate_gradient. A later GPU change needs a new check and a new record.
